mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code AS permission_code FROM app.employee_role er JOIN app.role r ON er.role_id = r.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN app.role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id JOIN app.permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE er.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
